1: // Nebula Runner – simple endless runner
2: // Target canvas with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return;
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Sound effects
9:   const sounds = {
10:     // short beep for collision
11:     collision: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAA=='),
12:     // lower tone for game over
13:     gameOver: new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAA=='),
14:   };
15:     // ensure sounds can overlap
16:   sounds.collision.preload = 'auto';
17:   sounds.gameOver.preload = 'auto';
18:   // point sound
19:   sounds.point = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQgAAA==');
20:   sounds.point.preload = 'auto';
21: 
22: 
23:   // size canvas to fill window and initialize stars
24:   const resize = () => {
25:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
26:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
27:     // repopulate starfield on resize
28:     stars.length = 0;
29:     for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {
30:       stars.push({
31:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
32:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
33:         r: Math.random() * 2 + 0.5,
34:         speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2,
35:       });
36:     }
37:   };
38:   // starfield array
39:   const stars = [];
40:   resize();
41:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
42: 
43:   // Ship definition
44:   const ship = {
45:     x: canvas.width * 0.1,
46:     y: canvas.height / 2,
47:     w: 30,
48:     h: 20,
49:     speed: 4,
50:     color: '#0ff',
51:   };
52: 
53:   // Input handling
54:   const keys = {};
55:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
56:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
57: 
58:   // Asteroid pool
59:   const asteroids = [];
60:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
61:   let lastSpawn = 0;
62: 
63:   const random = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
64: 
65:   function spawnAsteroid() {
66:     const size = random(20, 50);
67:     asteroids.push({
68:       x: canvas.width + size,
69:       y: random(0, canvas.height - size),
70:       w: size,
71:       h: size,
72:       speed: random(2, 6),
73:       color: '#888',
74:     });
75:   }
76: 
77:   // Collision detection (AABB)
78:   function collides(a, b) {
79:     return a.x < b.x + b.w && a.x + a.w > b.x && a.y < b.y + b.h && a.y + a.h > b.y;
80:   }
81: 
82:   let gameOver = false;
83:   let score = 0;
84:   let lastTime = 0;
85: 
86:   function update(dt) {
87:   // move stars for parallax background
88:   for (const s of stars) {
89:     s.x -= s.speed;
90:     if (s.x < 0) {
91:       s.x = canvas.width;
92:       s.y = Math.random() * canvas.height;
93:     }
94:   }
95:     // ship movement
96:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
97:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
98:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
99:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
100:     // keep inside bounds
101:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.w, ship.x));
102:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height - ship.h, ship.y));
103: 
104:     // spawn asteroids
105:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
106:       spawnAsteroid();
107:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
108:     }
109: 
110:     // update asteroids
111:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
112:       const a = asteroids[i];
113:       a.x -= a.speed;
114:       if (a.x + a.w < 0) {
115:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
116:         score++;
117:         sounds.point.currentTime = 0;
118:         sounds.point.play();
119:         continue;
120:       }
121:       if (collides(ship, a)) {
122:         if (!gameOver) {
123:           sounds.collision.currentTime = 0;
124:           sounds.collision.play();
125:           sounds.gameOver.currentTime = 0;
126:           sounds.gameOver.play();
127:         }
128:         gameOver = true;
129:       }
130:     }
131:   }
132: 
133:   function draw() {
134:     // clear with dark gradient
135:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
136:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
137:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
138:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
139:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
140: 
141:     // draw starfield
142:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
143:     for (const s of stars) {
144:       ctx.beginPath();
145:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
146:       ctx.fill();
147:     }
148: 
149:     // draw ship (triangle) with glow
150:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
151:     ctx.beginPath();
152:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
153:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
154:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
155:     ctx.closePath();
156:     ctx.fill();
157: 
158:     // draw asteroids
159:     for (const a of asteroids) {
160:       ctx.fillStyle = a.color;
161:       ctx.beginPath();
162:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2, a.w / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
163:       ctx.fill();
164:     }
165: 
166:     // UI
167:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
168:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
169:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
170:     if (gameOver) {
171:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
172:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
173:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
174:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
175:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
176:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
177:     }
178:   }
179: 
180:   function loop(timestamp) {
181:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
182:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
183:     lastTime = timestamp;
184: 
185:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
186:     draw();
187:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
188:   }
189: 
190:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
191: })();

(End of file - total 191 lines)
